name: Fenrisúlfr
introduce:
OS-10S 芬里厄
由西塞罗实验室设计，经黑曜石改良后的中型格斗机兵。与OS-13S海拉为同代机。
其搭载的哈提装置，能绕过绝大多数的机载干扰系统，对敌机进行锁定。并为OS-10S的追击系统提供强劲动能。由于布莱尔政权的倒台，OS-10S并未完成量产，仅有的数台试验机型封存在米赫玛岛的掠食者实验室中，并最终由联合军部接手。芬里厄在定位和技术上是否会有新的突破仍犹未可知。

20494.name: Hrodvitnir Unit
20494.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, has a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> DMG. For every <color=#F74848>15%</color> decrease in HP percentage, trigger chance increases by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

30398.name: Ulfhednar Mod
30398.SpecificEffects:
When attacking, if this unit's HP percentage is below <color=#F74848>60%</color>, ignores <color=#F74848>35%</color> of the target's Armor and <color=#F74848>18%</color> of Dodge.
ST Movement increased by <color=#F74848>1</color> tile. Ignores unit obstruction when moving, and when attacking enemy STs along the movement path, its triggered <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> effect is replaced with <buf ID=900010>[Gutsy Strike]</buf>.
